sentences.text: The above Writ Petition is filed inter alia to direct Respondent No.3 to deposit the amount of compensation regarding the land acquisition in the Civil Court, Ratnagiri in Civil Suit No.232 of 2021.

The Writ Petition has been moved urgently today for ad-interim relief because it is the apprehension of the Petitioner that the Competent Authority is going to disburse the compensation to Respondent Nos.6, 7 & 8 even though they are not entitled to the same.
We have heard the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Petitioner.

Since this Writ Petition is coming up for the first time we issue notice to Respondent Nos. 5 to 8 returnable on 11 th October,
